description: Monty on the Run (C64, Gremlin Graphics 1985) reverse engineering: gameplay, every room, graphics, Rob Hubbard's music and effects, architecture, data formats, toolchain and verification notes.
includes: VICE screenshots of all 52 rooms and both endings, a world map, decoded tiles, decorations, sprites and enemies, animations, the three songs and every sound effect as playable audio, and diagrams
